summary: Layer 1B expansion found four US-listed or US-traded candidates tied to transformer, switchgear, magnetics, and adjacent grid hardware chokepoints. The cleanest direct node exposures are Hammond Power Solutions via US OTC/TSX primary listing, Powell Industries in medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems, and Bel Fuse in lower-voltage data-center power conversion and magnetics. Preformed Line Products is a second-order adjacent chokepoint: not a transformer maker, but potentially leveraged to transmission buildout hardware required before grid construction crews arrive. Large diversified leaders such as Eaton, Hubbell, Siemens Energy, GE Vernova, Vertiv, and Schneider remain important reference comparables but are not prioritized in this underfollowed pass.
